methodology.summary: Calibrated daily forecasting platform with anchored walk-forward evaluation, trend-first daily path modeling, trust scoring, and premarket inference refresh.
methodology.selection: Champion chosen by Brier score, log loss, recent walk-forward hit rate, regime stability, trend stability, and calibration.
methodology.policy: Signals are derived from probabilities plus trust; trend provides a structural prior, and meta-policy can shrink confidence but not override direction.

promotion.reason: Promotion requires PLTR plus at least two peers to improve recent matured Brier or log loss.
